brief: A display stand with the large platform on a spike where three bases meet.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Three bases meeting at one junction to receive a spike
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full clustered around junction [0,0 / 0,1 / 1,0] - spike socket S14/S20 offered and used

requirements.requirement: Spike mounted where the three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 variant mount placed at level 0 junction x=47.8 y=0 z=82.9

requirements.requirement: Large platform on the spike (display surface)
requirements.evidence: setSpikeAccessory platform-lrg applied to spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 - BOM shows spike-acc-platform-lrg qty 1, platform size ~52x60mm, mount spike traps it between bases

requirements.requirement: Display stand function (stable base for displaying an item)
requirements.evidence: Triangular 3-base footprint 364x384mm, spike mount central, caps and joint bolts applied, meshClash clear - provides stable elevated platform for display

finish.summary: Built triangular display stand from three full hex bases clustered at one junction, with mount spike and trapped large platform (platform-lrg) forming the display surface. Capped open faces and locked joints, verified clear meshes.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
